aiVerification.summary: Draft captures the main method-change context but has material outcome extraction and grouping errors.
issues: Changed condition wrongly includes Total as part of the factor.
Function outcome appears miscomputed as zero NG despite cited normal row showing defect totals.
Tension spec violations are missed; rows with min below 1.9 are marked violationCount 0.
Tension row grouping is malformed for rows with merged process/type fields.
Header-only measurement outcomes from rows 14 and 41 are not valid standalone evidence.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to normal dry UC press VP/CD vs change method UC press VP/CD; keep Total only as aggregate subgroup.
Re-extract Function table using its full header and all NG total/rate columns.
Recompute tension pass/fail against ≥1.9 Kgf and preserve date/type grouping.
Remove header-only measurement outcomes unless supported by data rows.
Cite section headers plus exact compared data and total rows for each outcome.
